senses.gloss:
तर 1. तर, a Taddhita affix, the termina-
[]
tion of the comparative degree, sometimes added ad-
verbially in the form तराम्; [cf. कष्ट-तर, &c.]

तर 2. तर, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. rt. तॄ), who or
what passes over or beyond, crossing; surpassing;
conquering, overpowering; excelling; to be crossed,
to be overcome [cf. दुस्-तर and दुष्-टर]; (अस्),
m. passing over, crossing, passage; freight; a road (?);
a ferry-boat, raft (?); a tree (?); a sort of magical spell
against the evil spirits supposed to possess certain wea-
pons; N. of a man; (for तरी see तरि next col.)
—तर-पण्य, अम्, n. ferriage, freight, the price
or fare paid at a ferry.
—तर-पण्यिक, अस्, m. one
who receives the ferriage or freight.
—तर-स्थान,
अम्, n. a landing-place, a wharf or stairs.

तार तार, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. तॄ, or in the
senses ‘shining,’ ‘star,’ &c., for स्तार fr. rt. स्तृ,
to scatter rays of light, or according to others fr. rt.
2. अस्, cf. अस्त्र), all-pervading, all-conquering, a
protector; an epithet of Rudra and Viṣṇu; high
(as a note in music), soprano; loud, shrill; a loud
or shrill note, a high tone or note (in music); shin-
ing, radiant, radiating; clean, clear; good, excellent,
well flavoured, &c.; (अस्), m. descent to a river, a
bank [cf. तीर and तीर्थ]; crossing, passing over,
&c.; the clearness or transparency of a pearl, a clear
or beautiful pearl; the (saving) mystical syllable ॐ
(प्रणव); a mystical monosyllable in the Tantras;
N. of a Daitya slain by Viṣṇu; N. of one of Rāma's
monkey generals, who was a son of Bṛhas-pati, and
whose wife is called Tārā; N. of Maṇi-rāma, a
commentator on the Bhāminī-vilāsa; (अस्, आ, अम्),
m. f. n. a star in general, a fixed star, asterism, &c.
[cf. तृ and स्तृ]; (आ), f. a star, planet, a kind of meteor,
perhaps a falling star; the pupil of the eye, (according
to some also m. and n.); N. of one of the eight
Siddhis in the Sāṅkhya phil.; a kind of perfume;
N. of the wife of Bṛhas-pati who was carried off by
Soma; of a form of Dākṣāyaṇī worshipped on the
mountain Kiṣkindha, protectress of the Gṛtsa-madas;
of the wife of Buddha Amogha-siddha; of one
of the Jaina Śaktis; of a female monkey in the
Rāmāyaṇa, daughter of Su-ṣeṇa, wife of Bālin and
mother of Aṅgada; N. of the wife of Tāra; (अम्),
n. silver; (अस्, अम्), m. n. camphor; (अम्, आ),
n. f. a pearl; [cf. Zend śtārĕ; Gr. ἀστήρ, ἄστρον;
Goth. stairno; Lat. aster, astrum, stella for ste-
rula.]
—तार-ज, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), a kind of
mineral substance.
—तार-तण्डुल, अस्, m. a kind of
Sorghum (धवल-यावनाल).
—तार-तम, अस्, आ,
अम्, very loud.
—तार-तार, अम्, n., N. of one of the
eight Siddhis in the Sāṅkhya phil.; [cf. तार and
तारा.]
—तार-नाथ, अस्, m. (for तारा-न्˚), N. of a
renowned Tibetian who lived in the beginning of the
seventeenth century and wrote a history of Buddhism.
—तार-नाद, अस्, m. a loud or shrill sound or cry.
—तार-पतन, अम्, n. the falling of a meteor, a
falling star.
—तार-पाल, अस्, m., N. of a lexico-
grapher.
—तार-पुष्प, अस्, m. jasmine.
—तार-
माक्षिक, अम्, n. a kind of mineral substance, =
तार-ज.
—तार-मूल and तार-मूलक, अम्, n.,
N. of a place.
—तार-विमला, f. a sort of mineral
said to be of the colour of silver.
—तार-शुद्धि-
कर, अम्, n. (‘what refines silver’), lead.
—तार-
सार, अस्, m., N. of an Upaniṣad.
—तार-स्वर,
अस्, आ, अम्, having a loud or shrill sound.
—तारा-
कवच, अम्, n., N. of a chapter in the Tantra-sāra
by Kṛṣṇānanda; see कवच.
—तारा-कारुण्य,
अम्, n. ‘the compassion of Tārā,’ N. of a chapter in
the Rāmāyaṇa.
—ताराक्ष (˚रा-अक्˚), अस्, ई, अम्,
star-eyed, one whose eyes are stars; (अस्), m., N. of
a Daitya, = तारकाक्ष, uncle of Dhūmrākṣa and
king of the Niṣadhas.
—तारा-ग्रह, ‘star-planet,’
i. e. one of the five lesser planets exclusive of the
sun and moon.
—तारा-चक्र, अम्, n., N. of a
mystical circle.
—तारा-चन्द्र, अस्, m., N. of a
scholiast and of a king.
—तारा-च्छाय, अस्, आ, अम्,
reflecting the stars.
—ताराधिप, अस्, m. or तारा-
धिपति (˚रा-अध्˚), इस्, m. ‘ruler of the stars,’
the moon.
—ताराधीश (˚रा-अध्˚), अस्, m., N. of
a prince.
—तारा-पज्झटिका, f., N. of a hymn
written by Śaṅkarācārya.
—तारा-पति, इस्, m. ‘lord
of the stars,’ the moon; a N. of Bṛhas-pati as
husband of Tārā; N. of Śiva; of the monkey Bālin;
of a prince.
—तारा-पथ, अस्, m. the path of the
stars, the atmosphere, the firmament, heaven or
sky; N. of a country.
—तारापहरण (˚रा-अप्˚),
[]
अम्, n., N. of a chapter in the Brahmavaivarta-
Purāṇa.
—तारापीड (˚रा-आप्˚), अस्, m. the moon
(‘having a chaplet of stars’); N. of several princes.
—तारा-प्रमाण, अम्, n. sidereal measure,
sidereal time.
—ताराभ (˚र or ˚रा-आभ), अस्,
m. quicksilver, (‘looking like silver or bright as the
stars.’)
—तारा-भूषा, f. ‘decorated with stars,’ an
epithet of the night.
—ताराभ्र (˚रा-अभ्˚), अस्,
m. camphor.
—तारा-मण्डल, अम्, n. the starry
region, the sphere of the stars, the zodiac; the
pupil of the eye; (अस्), m. a Śiva temple of a par-
ticular form or decorated in a peculiar manner.
—तारा-मन्त्र, अस्, m., N. of a chapter in the
Mantra-mahodadhi.
—तारा-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, con-
sisting of stars.
—तारा-मृग, अस्, m. the star-
antelope, the Nakṣatra Mṛga-śīrṣa.
—तारारि (˚र-
अरि), इस्, m. a pyritic ore of iron; see विड्-माक्षिक.
—तारा-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, star-shaped, star-like.
—तारा-वती, f., N. of a form of Durgā; of a
daughter of Kakut-stha and Mano-māthinī, wife of
king Candra-śekhara; of the wife of Dharma-dhvaja,
who was a king of Kāñcana-pura.
—तारा-वर्ष,
अम्, n. ‘star-rain,’ falling stars.
—तारावली (˚रा-
आव्˚), f., N. of a daughter of the Yakṣa prince
Maṇi-bhadra.
—तारा-वाक्य, अम्, n. ‘the speech of
Tārā,’ N. of a chapter in the fourth book of the
Rāmāyaṇa.
—तारा-विलाप, अस्, m. ‘the lamentation
of Tārā,’ N. of a chapter in the fourth book of the
Rāmāyaṇa.
—तारा-स्थान, अम्, n. the place in the
gamut for the treble notes, those of the higher
octave.
—तारेन्द्र (˚रा-इन्˚), अस्, m. ‘the prince
of the stars,’ N. of an author.

1. तरङ्ग, अस्, m. (perhaps fr. तरम् + ग), a
wave; a name given to sections of certain literary
works (especially when the title contains such a word
as ‘sea,’ ‘river,’ &c., e. g. of the Kathā-sarit-sāgara
and Rāja-taraṅgiṇī); a jumping motion, a leap, a
jump, the gallop of a horse, waving, moving to and
fro; cloth or clothes; [cf. उत्-तरङ्ग and चर्म-
तरङ्ग.]
—तरङ्ग-भीरु, उस्, m., N. of a son
of the fourteenth Manu.
—तरङ्गापत्रस्त (˚ग-
अप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, a little afraid of waves (Pāṇ. II. 1, 38).

2. तरङ्ग, nom. P. तरङ्गति, -गितुम्, to move
like a billow, wave, move to and fro.
तरङ्ग तरङ्ग. See col. 1.
तरङ्गक, अस्, m. a wave; [cf. नारी-तरङ्गक.]

तरङ्गित, अस्, आ, अम्, wavy, billowy, tossing with
waves; overflowing; (अम्), n. waving, moving to
and fro.

तरङ्गिन्, ई, इणी, इ, wavy, moving like a billow,
moving restlessly^1 to and fro, unsteady; (इणी), f. a
river; (sometimes at the end of the title of a literary
work, e. g. क्षीर-तरङ्गिणी, राज-त्˚.)
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210422. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/60.

तरण, अस्, m. a raft, a boat; Svarga or paradise
(the final landing-place); (अम्), n. crossing over,
passing, going across, carrying over, transporting;
conquering, overcoming; an oar; (for तरणी see
under तरणि below; cf. also सु-तरण.)

तारण, अस्, ई, अम्, who or what causes or enables
to cross; helping over a difficulty &c.; liberating,
saving; (अस्), m. a N. of Śiva and of Viṣṇu; a
raft, a float; (अम्), n. crossing, reaching the opposite
shore, safe passage; conquering; carrying or con-
[]
veying across, the act of saving or liberating; a sort
of sacrificial vessel (?); N. of a Sāman; N. of the
third year of the fourth Jupiter cycle.

तरणि, इस्, इस् or ई, इ, Ved. passing through, per-
vading (space &c., said of the sun); moving forwards,
quick, untired, energetic; bringing or carrying over,
saving, helping, benevolent; (इस्), m. the sun; the
plant Calotropis Gigantea [cf. अर्क]; a ray of light;
(इस् or ई), f. a float, a raft, a boat, ferry-boat; the
plant Aloe Perfoliata or Hibiscus Mutabilis; (accord-
ing to others = तरणी-वल्ली), a kind of rose, Rosa
Glandulifera; [cf. गो-तरणि.]
—तरणि-त्व, अम्,
n., Ved. quickness, eagerness, zeal.
—तरणि-धन्य,
अस्, m. an epithet of Śiva.
—तरणि-पेटक, अस्, m.
an oval bowl or bason of wood for baling a boat.
—तरणि-रत्न, अम्, n. a ruby (‘a sun-jewel’).
—तरणी-वल्ली, f. a kind of rose, Rosa Glandu-
lifera.
तारणि, इस्, f. = तरणि, a boat, ship.
तरणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be crossed or passed over.
तरण्डक, अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.

तरण्य (fr. तरण), nom. P. तरण्यति, &c.,
to cross over.

तरत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, crossing, passing over.
—त-
रद्-द्वेषस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. conquering or over-
powering enemies, an epithet of Indra.

तरत्समन्दीय, अम्, n., scil. सूक्तम्, the Sūkta
beginning with the words तरत् स मन्दी.
तरद्, त्, f. a raft, a float; a kind of duck.

तरन्त, अस्, m. the ocean; a hard shower, a
torrent of rain; a frog; N. of a man with the patro-
nymic Vaidadaśvi; (ई), f. a boat, ship.

तरन्तुक, अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha; [cf. त-
रण्डक.]
तरन्तुक तरन्तुक. See col. 1.

तरल, अस्, आ, अम्, moving to and fro, trembling,
tremulous; fickle, splendid, glittering, sparkling, lu-
minous; unsteady, vain; liquid, liquefied; libidinous,
lecherous, wanton; hollow; (अस्), m. the central
gem of a necklace; a necklace; iron; a level sur-
[]
face (= तल); bottom, depth, lower or under part;
the thorn-apple; N. of a poet; (आ), f. rice-gruel;
wine, vinous or spirituous liquor; a bee; (आस्), m.
pl., N. of a race.
—तरल-ता, f. or तरल-त्व,
अम्, n. tremulousness, unsteadiness, sprightliness.
—तरल-नयनी, f. a woman having tremulous or
rolling eyes; N. of a metre consisting of four lines of
twelve short syllables each.
—तरल-लेखा, f., N. of
a woman.
—तरल-लोचना, f. a woman with tremu-
lous eyes.
तरल तरल. See col. 1.

तारल तारल, अस्, ई, अम् (= तरल), un-
steady; libidinous, dissipated, a lecher.

तरलय, nom. P. तरलयति, -यितुम्, to cause
to tremble, impart a tremulous motion; to wave,
flutter, move to and fro.

तरलाय, nom. A. तरलायते, &c., to tremble,
move to and fro.

तरलायित, अस्, आ, अम्, caused to tremble, made
tremulous, agitated, waving to and fro, undulating;
(अस्), m. a large wave, surf; (अस् or अम्), m. or n. (?),
fickleness.
तरलिका, f., N. of a woman.

तरलित, अस्, आ, अम्, shaking, dangling, moving
to and fro, undulating, trembling, tremulous.
—त-
रलित-हार, अस्, आ, अम्, having a tremulous garland.

तरस्, अस्, n. rapid progress, speed, velocity;
strength, energy, efficacy; a bank; a float, a raft;
a ferry, a place of crossing: a symbolical N. of
Stoma; (आस्, आस्, अस्), Ved. pervading, quick, ener-
getic; तरसा, ind. speedily, quickly, directly,
energetically.
—तरस्-मत्, आन्, m., N. of a son of
the fourteenth Manu.
—तरस्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved.
quick, swift (e. g. तरस्-वत्यस्, ‘the swift ones,’
i. e. the rivers); valiant, energetic, an epithet of
Indra.
—तरस्-विन्, ई, इनी, इ, Ved. quick, swift,
strong, violent, energetic, courageous, bold; (ई), m.
a courier, an express, a runner; a hero; air, wind;
an epithet of Garuḍa, the bird of Viṣṇu.
तरस् तरस्, तरसा, &c. See col. 2.

तरस, अम्, n. meat, flesh.
—तरस-मय, अस्,
ई, अम्, consisting of meat.
तरसान, अस्, m. a boat.

तरान्धु or तरालु, उस्, m. a large flat-bottomed
boat.

तरि, इस्, f. a boat, ship; a clothes-basket; the
end of a cloth; (ई, ईस् or ई), f. a boat; a clothes-
basket; the hem of a garment; a small wooden
baling-vessel; a club; smoke.
—तरि-रथ, अस्, m.
an oar, a paddle.

तरिक, अस्, m. a ferry-man; a float, a raft, a
boat; (आ), f. a boat; cream.
तारिक, अम्, n. fare, freight, toll for passage.
तारिक तारिक, तारिन्. See under तार above.
तारिका, f. See under तारक, col. 1.
तरिकिन्, ई, m. a ferry-man.

तरितव्य or तरीतव्य or तर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्,
to be crossed or passed over, to be carried over or
across.

तरितृ or तरीतृ, ता, त्री, तृ, who or what
crosses, passes or carries over; (त्री), f. a boat, a raft.
तरित्र, अम्, n. a boat, a ship.

तरिन्, ई, इणी, इ, who or what crosses; crossing;
(इणी), f. a boat.

तारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, enabling or causing to get over
or across, saving; (इणी), f. a form of Durgā, =
द्वितीया शक्तिः; N. of a kind of goddess with
Buddhists.
—तारिणी-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a section
of the Śakti-ratnākara.

तरीयस्, आन्, असी, अस्, Ved. easily passing through
or pervading; (Sāy.) easy to be passed through.

तारीष तारीष, an incorrect form for ता-
वीष, q. v.

तरीषन् (occurring only as a loc. or Vedic inf.
तरीषणि), Ved. passing through, going across.

तरु 2. तरु, उस्, m. (said to be fr. rt. तॄ;
for 1. तरु see col. 2), a tree; N. of a son of Manu
Cākṣuṣa; (तरु in the sense of ‘tree’ does not
appear to occur in the Veda or Manu; it is perhaps
a modern derivation fr. द्रु; but according to Sāy.
it is used in Ṛg-veda V. 44, 5, in the sense of
‘wooden ladle;’ cf. 1. तरु, col. 2); [cf. Lat. termes.]
—तरु-खण्ड, अस्, अम्, m. n. an assemblage of
trees; (also तरु-षण्ड.)
—तरु-च्छाया, f. the
shade of a tree.
—तरु-ज, अस्, आ, अम्, produced by
a tree (as a flower, fruit, &c.).
—तरु-जीवन, अम्,
n. the root of a tree, i. e. the vital organ of a
tree.
—तरु-तल, अस्, m. the part under the
branches of a tree, the ground about its root, the
foot of a tree.
—तरु-ता, f. the state of a tree, the
being a tree.
—तरु-तूलिका or (according to another
reading) तरु-दूलिका, f. the flying fox (suspended
like a balance from the branches of a tree); [cf. वा-
तुलि.]
—तरु-नख, अस्, m. a thorn, (‘a tree-nail.’)
—तरु-पङ्क्ति, इस्, f. a row of trees, an avenue.
—तरु-भुज्, क्, m. a kind of parasitical plant, Vanda
Roxburghii; [cf. तरु-रुहा, तरु-रोहिणी, तरु-
स्था.]
—तरु-महिमन्, आ, m. a section in the
Vṛkṣāyur-veda which treats of the future rewards
of those who plant trees.
—तरु-मृग, अस्, m. ‘a
tree-animal,’ a monkey, an ape.
—तरु-राग, अस् or
अम्, m. or n. (?), a sprout; a bud, a blossom.
—तरु-
राज, अस्, m. ‘the king of trees,’ the palmyra-
tree; [cf. तृण-राज.]
—तरु-राजन्, आ, m. ‘the
king of the trees,’ an epithet of the Pārijāta.
—तरु-रुहा, f. and तरु-रोहिणी, f. ‘growing
on trees,’ a parasitical plant, = तरु-भुज्.
—तरु-
वर, अस्, m. an excellent tree, the best of trees, an
epithet of the Pārijāta.
—तरु-वल्ली, f. a kind of
plant; [cf. पर्पटी.]
—तरु-विटप, अस्, m. a
branch or sprout.
—तरु-शायिन्, ई, m. a bird (‘sleep-
ing on trees’).
—तरु-श्रेष्ठ, अस्, m. the best of
[]
trees.
—तरु-षण्ड, अस्, m. a group of trees.
—तरु-सार, अस्, m. ‘essence of trees,’ camphor.
—तरु-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, staying or being in a tree;
(आ), f. a parasitical plant.
तरूतृ = तरुतृ, at p. 365, by Pāṇ. VII. 2, 34.

तरुत्र, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. carrying across; over-
coming, conquering.

तरुष, अस्, m., Ved. a conqueror, overcomer;
(ई), f. victory.
तरुश, अस्, आ, अम्, abounding in trees.

तरुष्य (fr. the next), nom. P. तरुष्यति,
&c., Ved. to attack, overcome, conquer.

तरुस्, उस्, n., Ved. battle; superiority; (Sāy.)
overcoming.

तरूषस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. (Sāy.) overcoming,
conquering, saving, protecting; (अस्), n. rescue (?).

तरक्ष तरक्ष, अस्, m. or तरक्षु, उस्, m.
or तरक्षुक, अस्, m. a hyena, or perhaps a
tiger (?).

तरट तरट, a kind of medicinal plant,
commonly ṭāmMMkalā; [cf. तरदी.]

तरत्सल तरत्सल, अस्, m. conflagration of
chaff; (perhaps a wrong reading.)

तरदी तरदी, f., N. of a thorny plant
(= तारदी, तीव्रा, खर्वुरा, रक्त-वीजका; some
read also तरटी and तारटी).

तारदी तारदी, f. a kind of plant, = तरदी;
also read तारटी (तरटी).

तरबालिका तरबालिका, f. a kind of sword,
= करबालिका; [cf. तरवारि.]

तरवट तरवट, the plant Cassia Auri-
culata.

तरवारि तरवारि, इस्, m. a sword, a scymi-
tar; [cf. तरबालिका.]

तरवी तरवी, in astrology = تربيع quadra-
ture.

तरसन्ती तरसन्ती, f. (fr. rt. त्रस्), Ved. the
female of a deer.
तराम् तराम्, an adverbial form of 1. तर.

तरिता तरिता, f. (perhaps fr. rt. तॄ), the
fore-finger; garlic, or perhaps hemp; a form of
Durgā; [cf. तारिणी.]
—तरिता-धारणा-यन्त्र
and तरिता-पूजा-यन्त्र, अम्, n. mystic diagrams
given in the Tantra-sāra.

तारित, अस्, आ, अम्, made to cross, conveyed
across, saved.

तरुकूणि तरुकूणि, इस्, m. a sort of bird,
= वाग्गुद.

तरुक्ष तरुक्ष, अस्, m., N. of a man; [cf.
तारुक्षायणि, तारुक्ष्य, तलुक्ष.]

तरुण तरुण, अस्, ई, अम् (said to be fr. rt.
तॄ), young, tender, juvenile; new, fresh; a young
man, one of the virile age; fresh, lively, vivid;
risen only a short time ago (as the sun), not yet
high in the sky; (अस्), m. the castor-oil plant, Ricinus
Communis; large cumin seed, = कुब्ज-पुष्प, the
blossom of Achyranthes Aspera; N. of one of the
Saptarṣayas in the eleventh Manv-antara; N. of a
Gandharva; N. of a particular section in a mystical
Tantra work treating of various stages in the life of the
Tāntrika; (ई), f. a young woman, a girl from about
sixteen years of age; N. of several plants; a kind of
pot-herb, Aloe Perfoliata; also = तरणी, Rosa Glan-
dulifera; also = दन्ती, a kind of flower, = सहा,
कुमारी, गन्धाढ्या, चारु-केशरा, &c.; a kind
of perfume, commonly चीडा; (अम्), n. cartilage [cf.
तरुणास्थि below]; a sprout; [cf. तलुन; cf. also
Gr. τέρην, τέρεινα; Old Germ. diorna, ‘maiden;’
Old Island. therna.]
—तरुण-ज्वर, अस्, m. a fever
that lasts a week.
—तरुण-दधि, इ, n. coagulated
milk five days old.
—तरुण-पीतिका, f. red arsenic.
—तरुणाभास (˚ण-आभ्˚), अस्, m. a kind of cu-
cumber.
—तरुणास्थि (˚ण-अस्˚), इ, n. ‘soft-bone;’
cartilage, gristle.
—तरुणी-कटाक्ष-माल, अस्, m.,
N. of a plant, = तिलक.
—तरुणी-गण, अस्, m. a
number of young women.
—तरुणी-जन, अस्, m. a
young woman.

तारुण तारुण, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. तरुण), youth-
ful, young, adolescent.

तरुणक, अस्, m., N. of a serpent-demon; (अम्),
n. a sprout.

तरूणक तरूणक, अम्, n. (probably a wrong
reading for तरुणक), Ved. a sprout.

तरुणाय, nom. P. -यति, &c., to bring forth; A. त-
रुणायते, &c., to become or remain young or fresh.
तरुणय, Nom. P. तरुणयति, to make fresh.
तरुणिमन्, आ, m. youth, juvenility.
तरूट तरूट, अस्, m. the root of the lotus.

तर्क् तर्क्, cl. 10. P. (ep. also A.) तर्कयति,
-ते, तर्कयामास, तर्कयितुम्, to sup-
pose, conjecture, guess, suspect, make a guess, infer,
express an opinion, try to discover or ascertain,
reason, speculate about; to consider or regard as
(with two acc.); to reflect, think of, recollect, have
in one's mind, intend; to ascertain; to shine, to
speak; [cf. Lat. torqueo, torques, torcular, torvus;
Goth. threihan; Angl. Sax. thringan; Old Germ.
drayan; Mod. Germ. drehen; Goth. thagkyan;
Lith. tikiu?].

तर्क, अस्, m. supposition, conjecture; reasoning,
speculation, inquiry, meditation, discussion; doubt;
the science of logic, logic; a system of doctrine
founded on speculation or free thinking, a philoso-
phical system (especially one of the six, viz. Pūrva-
mīmāṃsā, Uttara-mīmāṃsā, Nyāya, Vaiśeṣika, Sāṅ-
khya, and Yoga); a name of the number six; (in
logic) confutation, reduction to absurdity, a conclusion
opposed to or disproving the premises; wish, desire;
supplying an ellipsis; cause, motive; (आ), f. specu-
lation, reasoning.
—तर्क-कारिका, f., N. of a work
setting forth the principles of the Vaiśeṣika phil.
by Jīva-rāja Dīkṣita.
—तर्क-कौमुदी, f., N. of
an elementary work on the Vaiśeṣika system.
—तर्क-ग्रन्थ, अस्, m. a treatise on reasoning,
manual of logic.
—तर्क-चन्द्रिका, f., N. of an ele-
mentary exposition of the Nyāya philosophy.
—तर्क-
ज्वाला, f. ‘the flame of speculation,’ N. of a Buddhist
work.
—तर्क-दीपिका, f., N. of a commentary
on the Tarka-saṅgraha.
—तर्क-प्रकाश, अस्, m.
= तर्क-भाषा-प्रकाश.
—तर्क-प्रदीप, अस्,
m., N. of a manual of Vaiśeṣika principles by
[]
Koṇḍa-bhaṭṭa.
—तर्क-भाषा or तर्कानुभाषा
(˚क-अन्˚) or तर्क-परिभाषा, f., N. of a manual-
of the Nyāya phil.
—तर्कभाषा-प्रकाश, अस्, m.
or तर्कभाषा-प्रकासिका, f. or तर्कभाषा-
भाव, अस्, m. or तर्कभाषा-सार-मञ्जरी, f.,
N. of certain commentaries on this work.
—तर्क-
मञ्जरी, f., N. of a commentary on the Tarka-
kārikā by the author of the original work.
—तर्क-
मुद्रा, f. a particular position of the hand.
—तर्क-
युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, conjectured, suspected.
—तर्क-
रत्न, अम्, n., N. of a Vaiśeṣika disquisition
by Koṇḍa-bhaṭṭa.
—तर्क-वाग्-ईश, अस्, m., N. of
several writers on the Nyāya phil.
—तर्क-विद्या,
f. the science of reasoning or logic, a logical treatise.
—तर्क-शास्त्र, अम्, n. the science of reasoning,
logic; a philosophical work.
—तर्क-सङ्ग्रह, अस्,
m., N. of a manual of the Vaiśeṣika branch of the
Nyāya phil. by Annam-bhaṭṭa.
—तर्कसङ्ग्रह-
दीपिका, f., N. of a commentary on the preceding
by the same author.
—तर्काभास (˚क-आभ्˚), अस्,
m. apparent reasoning, fallacy in drawing conclusions,
incompatibility of conclusion and premises.
—तर्का-
मृत (˚क-अम्˚), अम्, n., N. of an elementary
work on the Vaiśeṣika doctrine by Jagad-īśa Tar-
kālaṅkāra Bhaṭṭācārya.
—तर्कामृत-चषक, N.
of a commentary on the preceding work by Gaṅ-
gārāma Jaḍī.
—तर्कामृत-तरङ्गिणी, f., N. of
a commentary on the Tarkāmṛta by Mukunda
Bhaṭṭa Gāḍegila.

तर्कक, अस्, आ, अम्, inquiring, inquisitive, investi-
gating; (अस्), m. a suppliant, a petitioner, an asker,
an inquirer; a logician.

तर्कण, अम्, n. conjecturing, reasoning, specu-
lating.

तर्कणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be suspected, to be an
object of the suspicion of others (with gen.); causing
suspicion.

तर्कयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, conjecturing, expecting,
anticipating, doubting, &c.

तर्कारी, f. the tree Sesbania Ægyptiaca, a kind of
gourd.

तर्किण or तर्किल, अस्, m. the tree Cassia Tora,
= चक्र-मर्द.

तर्कित, अस्, आ, अम्, investigated, examined, doubted,
discussed, &c.; (अम्), n. conjecture, supposition.

तर्किन्, ई, इणी, इ, conjecturing, supposing; reason-
ing, skilled in speculation or philosophy; (ई), m. a
logician, disputant, reasoner.
तर्कुक, अस्, m. a suppliant, beggar; [cf. तर्कक.]

तर्क्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be imagined or supposed,
capable of investigation or reasoning.

तर्कु तर्कु, उस्, उस्, m. f. (said to be fr. rt. कृत्,
with transposition of the consonants), a spindle, an
iron pin upon which the cotton is first drawn out and
which serves as the distaff, the cotton being next
transferred from it to the wheel; [cf. Gr. ἄ-τρακτος.]
—तर्कु-पिण्ड, अस्, m. a ball of clay &c. at the
lower end of a spindle to assist in giving it a rotatory
motion.
—तर्कु-पीठ, अस्, ई, m. f. or तर्कु-पाठी,
f. a ball at the lower end of a spindle.
—तर्कु-
लासक, अस्, m. a concave shell or saucer which serves
to hold the lower end of the spindle when whirled
round.
—तर्कु-शाण, अस्, m. a small whetstone for
sharpening spindles, &c.

तर्कुट, अम्, n. drawing out the cotton upon the
distaff or upon the wheel; spinning; (ई), f. a spindle,
a distaff.
तर्क्षु तर्क्षु, उस्, m. = तरक्षु, a hyena.
तर्क्ष्य तर्क्ष्य, अस्, m. nitre, saltpetre.

तार्क्ष्य, अस्, m. (a patronymic fr. तृक्ष), N.
of a mythical being, described either as a horse or
bird, and originally one of the personifications of the
sun, which was represented under these forms; (the
most ancient representation seems to have been that
of the horse: in Mahā-bh. 1. 2548, Tārkṣya,
Ariṣṭa-nemi, Garuḍa, Aruṇa, and Āruṇī are described
as children of Kaśyapa and Vinatā; Tārkṣya is also
called Garuḍāgra-ja, the elder brother of Garuḍa: in
Mahā-bh. III. 12660, mention is made of a Muni
[]
called Ariṣṭa-nemi Tārkṣya, but in the epic and
later literature Tārkṣya is generally identified with
Garuḍa, the bird and vehicle of Viṣṇu and destroyer
of the race of snakes); a N. of Garuḍa; a N. of
Śiva; a Vedic hymn supposed to be composed by
Ariṣṭa-nemi Tārkṣya; a horse in general; a car,
a chariot; a bird in general; N. of a race; a snake;
the tree Vatica Robusta [cf. तार्क्ष्य-प्रसव]; a
sort of antidote; gold; (ई), f. a wild creeper; (अम्),
n. a kind of drug; a sort of collyrium.
—तार्क्ष्य-
ज and तार्क्ष-ज, अम्, n. a sort of collyrium.
—तार्क्ष्य-ध्वज, अस्, m. an epithet of Viṣṇu
(whose symbol is Garuḍa).
—तार्क्ष्य-नायक,
अस्, m. ‘the leader or chief of the birds,’ an epithet
of Garuḍa.
—तार्क्ष्य-नाशक, अस्, m. ‘destroyer
of birds,’ the bird Falco Calidus.
—तार्क्ष्य-प्र-
सव, अस्, m. the tree Vatica Robusta; [cf. अश्व-
कर्ण and तार्क्ष्य.]
—तार्क्ष्य-शैल, अम्, n.
a substance prepared from the calx of brass or from
the Amomum Anthorrhiza, and used as a medical
application to the eyes; [cf. रसाञ्जन.]
—तार्-
क्ष्य-सामन्, अ, n., N. of a Sāman.

तर्ज् तर्ज्, cl. 1. P. (ep. also A.) तर्जति,
-ते, ततर्ज, तर्जितुम्, to threaten, me-
nace; to blame, censure, reprove; Caus. P. (ep. also
A.) तर्जयति, -ते, -यितुम्, to threaten; to scold,
censure; to frighten, terrify; to deride, mock; [cf.
Old Germ. trug, druk, triugu, driuku, ‘to cheat:’
Angl. Sax. threagan, ‘to chide;’ thracian, thraec:
Old Germ. dravyan: Mod. Germ. drohen.]

तर्जन, अम्, n. threatening, blaming, censuring;
[]
pointing at in ridicule or contempt; putting to shame,
surpassing; wrath, anger; (आ), f. threatening, censur-
ing; (ई), f. the fore-finger (as used for threatening).

तर्जनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be threatened, repre-
hensible.

तर्जित, अस्, आ, अम्, threatened, blamed, reviled;
shamed, disgraced; (अम्), n. threatening, menace.

तर्जिक तर्जिक, आस्, m. pl., N. of a country
or people, perhaps to the north-west of India or
Bokhara, the country of the Tājiks; (also तायिक
or ताजिक.)

तर्ण तर्ण or तर्णक, अस्, m. (perhaps cor-
rupted fr. तरुण), a calf.

तार्ण तार्ण, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. तृण), made of
grass; levied from grass (as a tax); (अस्, ई), m. f. a
patronymic from Tṛṇa.

तर्णि तर्णि, इस्, m. (fr. rt. तॄ), a float, a
raft; the sun.

तर्तरीक तर्तरीक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. Intens. of
rt. तॄ), being in the habit of passing or crossing over,
a passenger; (अम्), n. a boat, a raft, a vessel.
तर्तव्य, अस्, आ, अम्. See तरितव्य, p. 365, col. 2.

तर्द् तर्द् (connected with rt. तृद्) , cl. 1.
P. तर्दति, &c., to kill, injure, hurt; cut
through; [cf. rt. तृद्.]

तर्द, अस्, m., Ved. a species of bird; [cf. Lat.
turdus.]

तर्दू, ऊस्, m. f. ? (fr. rt. तृद्, but said to be fr.
rt. तॄ), a wooden ladle.
तर्द्मन्, अ, n., Ved. a hole, an opening, a cleft.

तर्पण तर्पण, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. rt. तृप्), satis-
fying, satiating, pleasing, refreshing [cf. घ्राण-
तर्पण]; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a kind of plant; (ई), f.,
N. of a plant, = गुरु-स्कन्ध, श्लेष्मणा; (अम्),
n. the becoming satisfied or satiated, the act of sati-
ating, refreshing, pleasing; satisfaction given or re-
ceived; the state of being pleased; satiety, fulness;
pleasure; a religious rite, libation, presenting libations
of water to the manes of the deceased or to the
Pitṛs collectively, also to the gods, either generally or
individually; gladdening; satiating the eyes, i. e. filling
them with oil &c.; food; fuel used on sacrificial
occasions or for lighting a sacrificial fire; a kind of
sweetmeat (?).
—तर्पण-विधि, इस्, m. a chapter of
the Smṛty-artha-sāra by Śrīdhara-svāmin on funeral
ceremonies &c.
—तर्पणेच्छु (˚ण-इच्˚), उस्, उस्,
उ, desirous of satisfaction or of receiving after death
the presentation of water called Tarpaṇa; (उस्), m.
an epithet of Bhīṣma.
तर्पणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be satiated or satisfied.

तर्पयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be satiated or re-
freshed.
तर्पयित्वा, ind. having satisfied.
तर्पित, अस्, आ, अम्, pleased, gratified, satisfied.

तर्पिन्, ई, इणी, इ, gratifying, giving pleasure or
satisfaction; offering oblations to the manes, one
who does so; (इणी), f. the plant Hibiscus Mutabilis
(पद्म-चारिणी).

तर्फितृ तर्फितृ, ता, त्री, तृ (fr. rt. तृफ्),
a killer, injurer.

तर्ब् तर्ब्, cl. 1. P. तर्बति, &c., to go
or move.

तर्बट तर्बट, अस्, m. a year; the plant
Cassia Tora, = चक्र-मर्द.

तर्य तर्य, अस्, m. (fr. rt. तॄ), Ved. (Sāy.)
N. of a man.

तार्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be crossed, passable, to be
carried across, to be ferried over, to be conquered or
defeated; (अम्), n. fare, freight, toll.
तार्य तार्य. See col. 2.

1. तर्ष, अस्, m. a raft or float; the ocean; the
sun; [cf. तरणि.]

तर्षण, अम्, n. thirsting, thirst; desiring, wish,
desire.
तर्षम्, ind. thirsting, being thirsty.

तर्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, thirsting, athirst, thirsty;
desiring, wishing for; [cf. तृषित.]

तर्षुल, अस्, आ, अम्, wishing, desiring; in अ-तर्-
षुल, without desire.
तर्ष्या-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. thirsty.

तर्हण तर्हण, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. rt. तृह्), Ved.
injuring, crushing, bruising; [cf. दस्यु-तर्हण.]

तर्हि तर्हि, ind. (fr. the pronom. base 2. त),
at that time, then, at that moment, in that case; in
the mean time; (this word occurs in the Veda, but
is rarely found in the earlier epic poetry); यदा —
तर्हि, when — then; यदि — तर्हि, यत्र — तर्हि,
चेद् — तर्हि, if — then; [cf. एतर्हि, कर्हि, यर्हि.]

तारक, अस्, इका, अम्, one who causes or enables
to pass or go over, carrying over; rescuing; one
who helps another through a difficulty &c.; a pro-
tector, a preserver (e. g. तारकम् ब्रह्म, ‘the
saving prayer,’ N. of a particular prayer which saves
or liberates); belonging to the stars; (अस्), m. a pilot,
a helmsman or steersman; a N. of Śiva; N. of
a Daitya conquered by Indra with the assistance of
Kārttikeya or Skanda; (Tāraka is also enumerated
among the nine enemies of Viṣṇu); N. of a friend
of Sīmanta; (आस्), m. pl. the children of Tāraka; (अस्,
अम्), m. n. a float, a raft; (अका), f. a star; a meteor,
a falling star. &c., (with Jainas constituting one of
the five divisions of the Jyotiṣkas); a sort of colo-
quintida; N. of a daughter of Sunda; of the wife of
Bṛhas-pati, usually called Tārā; also = लघु-वृन्-
दावन; (इका), f. the juice of palms, = ताल-रस,
commonly ताडी; (आ, अम्), f. n. the pupil of the
eye; the eye; (अम्), n., N. of a metre of four lines
of thirteen syllables each.
—तारक-जय, अस्, m.
‘conquest of Tāraka,’ N. of a chapter in the Padma-
Purāṇa.
—तारक-जित्, त्, m. ‘conqueror of Tāraka,’
epithet of Skanda.
—तारक-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of
a Tīrtha.
—तारक-वध, अस्, m. ‘the killing of
Tāraka,’ N. of a chapter in the Śiva-Purāṇa.
—ता-
रकाक्ष (˚का-अक्˚), अस्, ई, अम्, having stars for
eyes; (अस्), m., N. of a Daitya, a son of Tāraka.
—तारकाख्य (˚क-आख्˚), अस्, m., N. of a Daitya,
a son of Tāraka.
—तारकान्तक (˚क-अन्˚), अस्, m.
‘destroying Tāraka,’ an epithet of Skanda.
—ता-
रका-मय, अस्, ई, अम् (तारका = तारा), on account
of Tārā, by reason of Tārā, (generally used as an
epithet of either Saṅgrāma or Yuddha or Samara,
i. e. the war waged by gods and demons for the
rescue of Tārā, the wife of Bṛhas-pati, who had
been carried off by Soma); a N. of Śiva, as taking
part in that fight.
—तारका-मान, अम्, n. sidereal
measure, sidereal time.
—तारकारि (˚क-अरि), इस्,
m. ‘the enemy of Tāraka,’ an epithet of Skanda.
—तारकोपनिषद् (˚क-उप्˚), त्, f. ‘the saving or
liberating Upaniṣad,’ N. of an Upaniṣad.
तारकायण, अस्, m. a patronymic from Tāraka.
तारकित, अस्, आ, अम्, starry, star-spangled.
तारकिन्, ई, इणी, इ, starry; (इणी), f. night.

तारणेय, अस्, m. a patronymic of Yāja and
Upa-yāja.

तारयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, a liberator, promoter,
promoting, liberating.

तारायण, अस्, m. the tree of salvation, the holy
fig-tree.

तारेय, अस्, m. a metronymic of the monkey
Aṅgada; [cf. तारा.]

तारक्षति तारक्षति, तारक्षिति, and तिरि-
क्षति, N. of a district to the west of Madhya-deśa.

तारतम्य तारतम्य, अम्, n. (an abstract
noun from तर+तम, the affixes of the compara-
tive and superlative degrees), gradation, proportion,
the state or condition of more or less; dependance
of larger numbers on smaller in a progressive series;
(एन), ind. in different degrees, in various gradations.

तारल्य, अम्, n. tremulousness, unsteadiness, libi-
dinousness, wantonness.

ताराज् ता-राज्, ट्, f., N. of a kind of Virāj
metre.

तारुक्षायणि तारुक्षायणि, a patronymic
from Tarukṣa.

तारुक्ष्य, अस्, m. a patronymic from Tarukṣa;
(the fem. is तारुक्ष्यायणी.)
तारुण्य, अम्, n. youth, youthfulness.

तार्कव तार्कव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. तर्कु), spun,
woven, made with a spindle, belonging to a spindle.

तार्किक तार्किक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. तर्क), re-
lated or belonging to the science of reasoning or
logic, belonging to philosophy; (अस्), m. a dialecti-
cian, a logician, a philosopher, a sophist, a follower
of one of the six schools of Hindū philosophy.

तार्क्ष तार्क्ष, अस्, m. a kind of bird; a
kind of plant; a N. of Kaśyapa; a wrong reading
for तार्क्ष्य, i. e. Garuḍa; (ई), f. a sort of creeping
plant, = पाताल-गरुडी.
—तार्क्ष-ज = तार्क्ष्य-
ज, q. v.
—तार्क्ष-पुत्र or तार्क्ष-सुत, अस्, m.
‘the son of Tārkṣa or Kaśyapa,’ i. e. Garuḍa.
तार्क्षाक, a patronymic from Tṛkṣāka.

तार्क्ष्यायण, अस्, m. a patronymic from Tār-
kṣya.
—तार्क्ष्यायण-भक्त, अम्, n. the district
inhabited by the Tārkṣyāyaṇas.

तार्णक, अस्, ई, अम्, an adjective derived from
Tṛṇakīyā.
तार्णकर्ण, a patronymic from Tṛṇa-karṇa.

तार्णविन्दवीय, अस्, आ, अम्, sacred to Tṛṇa-
vindu.
तार्णायन, a patronymic from Tṛṇa.

तार्तीय तार्तीय, अस्, आ or ई (?), अम् (fr. तृतीय),
belonging to the third; the third; (अम्), n. a third
part.
—तार्तीयसवन or तार्तीयसवनिक, अस्, ई,
अम् (fr. तृतीय-सवन), belonging to the third
Savana; [cf. त्रि-षवण.]
—तार्तीयाह्निक, अस्, ई,
अम् (fr. तृतीय+अहन्), belonging to the third day.
तार्तीयक, belonging to the third, third.
तार्तीयीक, अस्, आ, अम्, the third.

तार्प्य तार्प्य, अम्, n., Ved. a garment made
of a particular vegetable substance; (according to
Sāy. derived fr. तृपा, a kind of plant.)

तार्ष्टाघ तार्ष्टाघ, अस्, m. (fr. तृष्टाघ ?),
a kind of tree; (अस्, ई, अम्), coming from or be-
longing to this tree.
